text: トンネルにも　ポケモン　いるのね　さっき　ワンリキーが　いたわ

structure.jp: トンネルにも　ポケモン　いるのね
structure.en: so there are Pokémon in tunnels too

structure.jp: さっき　ワンリキーが　いたわ
structure.en: there was a Machop a moment ago

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end, used here in a womanly way in place of のだ, shows the speaker has just understood something. いるのね = 'so there are some, I see'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to round off a statement; it adds no meaning. いたわ = 'there was one'.
